description: Get CBOE put/call ratio data showing market sentiment. Available types: Total (all exchange), Equity, Index, Vix, Etp. High ratios (>1.0) indicate bearish sentiment; low ratios (<0.7) indicate bullish sentiment. Volumes are contract counts. Data available from November 2006 to present (the Vix type from October 2019); pre-2013 history is sampled roughly weekly rather than daily.

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest available)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 60, max: 500). When the range holds more rows the newest are kept; rows are always listed oldest to newest.

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 3 months ago)

type.description: Ratio type: Total, Equity, Index, Vix, Etp (default: Equity)

name: GetPutCallRatios
title: CBOE Put/Call Ratios
